items.title: How an ad loads on a web page with header bidding
steps: A visitor opens the page
The header bidding script sends bid requests
Demand partners return their bids
The best bid is passed to the ad server
The ad server picks the final winner
The ad shows in the slot
items.why: Bids are collected before the ad server decides, so all demand competes at once.

items.title: How a publisher starts selling a new app
steps: Add the app to the ad platform
Add the app-ads.txt file to the developer site
Add the ad SDK to the app
Create ad units and placements
Test ads in the app
Release and watch the reports
items.why: Setup moves from approval, to code, to testing, then to live reporting.

items.title: How a CTV ad is delivered to a viewer
steps: The viewer starts a show in a streaming app
The app reaches an ad break
The app sends an ad request to the ad server
A demand platform bids and wins
The ad is served into the stream
Tracking pixels report the view
items.why: The ad request happens at the break, then the winning ad is delivered and measured.

items.title: How a DOOH campaign runs
steps: The advertiser picks screens and times
The creative is approved for the screens
The campaign is scheduled on the platform
Screens play the ad
Proof of play is recorded
Reach and results are reported
items.why: Proof of play confirms the ad really ran where and when it was booked.
